name: BotID
summary: Vercel BotID is an invisible CAPTCHA for high-value routes such as checkouts, signups and AI endpoints. A client-side challenge is checked on the server with checkBotId(); an optional Deep Analysis mode powered by Kasada uses machine learning on client signals. It can identify verified bots, such as ChatGPT's agent, so they can be allowed while others are blocked.
facts: Client challenge; Deep Analysis powered by Kasada
Basic free on all plans; Deep Analysis $1 per 1,000 checks on Pro
Next.js, SvelteKit, Nuxt and other JS frameworks
goodFor: Protecting expensive AI endpoints from scripted abuse
Letting verified agents through while blocking others
watchOut: Unverified but legitimate agents may be blocked
Deep Analysis is billed per check
